column3: MATERIAL REFERENCE close-up, eye height, about 1 m from a cave wall: wet black basalt with faint hexagonal columnar joints 40-80 cm across, conchoidal chips, glossy water film and trickles catching warm amber lantern highlights, a few mineral-white streaks, dark teal reflections at the base. Sharp focus on surface detail, shallow depth of field.

MATERIAL REFERENCE close-up: polished black obsidian floor slabs and the rounded rim of a still black pool, mirror-like reflections of paper lanterns and tiny teal glowworm dots, faint conchoidal fracture texture under the polish, wet edge where the stone meets the water.

MATERIAL REFERENCE close-up: travertine rimstone terrace rims, cream-white and pale ochre mineral crust with tiny scalloped micro-terraces and frilly lips, turquoise water spilling over each lip in thin sheets, steam, warm lantern rim light.

MATERIAL REFERENCE close-up interior detail: an aged hinoki cedar post and beam with raised silvery-brown grain and soft worn edges, a shoji screen of washi paper glowing warm from behind with visible fibres and a fine wooden lattice, a tatami floor edge with woven rush texture and dark cloth border. Warm intimate lighting.

MATERIAL REFERENCE: looking through a thick glass wall with bronze mullions at slowly moving lava a few metres beyond: black cooled crust broken into plates with glowing orange-yellow seams, a molten pour, heat shimmer, reflections of the room and lanterns on the glass, a hint of glass thickness at the edge.

MATERIAL REFERENCE looking down from 2 m: clear mineral water over dark stone, turquoise-teal where shallow over pale stepping stones, deepening to blue-black in deeper parts, soft caustic light patterns on the bottom, a thin layer of white mist drifting over the surface, warm lantern reflections.

MATERIAL REFERENCE close-up at the waterline inside a sea cave: glittering black volcanic sand, darker and glossy where wet, lighter matte where dry, a thin lace of white foam retreating, small basalt pebbles, moonlight from the cave mouth and warm lantern light from the beach.

MATERIAL REFERENCE close-up: blue glacier ice meeting black basalt in a cave: deep blue translucent ice with trapped bubbles and white fracture planes, milky surface frost, icicles dripping into a cold pool, cold blue light glowing through the ice.

Eye-level view inside the carved Spiral Stair: a wide stone helix staircase wrapping around a central glass-and-bronze lift core inside a round basalt shaft, looking down the well past several turns of stairs lit by warm wall lanterns, the lift car glowing, mist far below, a landing doorway opening to a lantern-lit level.

Eye-level view of the B1 lift lobby: a round cave hall ringing the spiral stair well and lift, two misty reflecting-pool corridors with stepping stones leaving it, low lantern niches, a level sign, steam drifting, the black water of the Obsidian Mirror glimpsed through one opening.

Eye-level view at the top of the Mist Steps: a wide switchback stone stair where a thin sheet of warm water flows down every step like a reflecting pool, mist rolling down with it, lanterns on the landings, and far below the magenta-cyan neon and warm lantern glow of the Kawagiri restaurant over the underground river.

Eye-level view of the changing hall: a calm hinoki hall with a backlit wall of shelves holding folded linen yukata, rows of wooden lockers, changing booths with indigo noren curtains, a long vanity with round mirrors, woven towel baskets, warm washi light, a low entry passage behind.

Eye-level view of the treatment rooms hall in a cave: a quiet timber walkway with shoji-fronted massage rooms on both sides glowing softly, and in the middle a small sunken courtyard garden (tsuboniwa) with moss, gravel, a niwaki pine and a stone lantern lit from above by a light well.

Eye-level view from the walkway carved BEHIND Thunder Curtain Falls: a heavy curtain of hot water falling right in front of a timber-railed rock gallery, lanterns on the back wall making the falling water glow amber and white, through the water a blurred view of the turquoise plunge pool and the great cavern beyond, spray and mist.

Eye-level view on the Lava Stair: a stone stair winding around a tall glass shaft containing the clear tube of the Magma Glass Slide, lava glowing orange behind thick glass on the outer wall, the slide tube lit orange from within, guests descending, warm and dramatic.

Eye-level view along the curving B4 tunnel gallery: a narrow timber walkway with dim lanterns through dark basalt, opening at the end into the vast magma viewing chamber where a long wall of thick glass shows a sea of glowing lava, silhouettes of guests on benches.

Eye-level view climbing the Terrace Path on the west flank of the volcano at blue hour: a stone switchback stair with lanterns, beside it a cascade of turquoise terrace pools stepping down the mountainside with waterfalls between them, steam, pine trees, the sea and clouds far below.

Eye-level view on the Cliff Stair on the north cliff: a stone stair cut into the basalt face with a timber railing, passing the balcony of a private suite with a glowing shoji front and a steaming stone tub fed by a trickle from above, the dark sea and sea stacks below, lanterns along the stair.

Eye-level view from the B3 lift lobby into the Aqua Cavern: the great dark vault opening up with glowworm-speckled roof, turquoise rimstone terraces stepping down on the left, the Thunder Curtain Falls glowing in the far west, the lava tube lazy river curving away, the geyser plaza plume in the middle distance, walkways and lanterns leading in.

Eye-level view walking along the Kawagiri spine deck: a timber deck on heavy beams over the fast turquoise underground river, private table pods on both sides each enclosed by a falling water curtain, tiny hinoki aqueducts on stilts, red paper lanterns, magenta and cyan neon kanji, steam and mist, diners inside.
